scope: Owned supplemental Linux namespace IPv6 ESP path with manually provisioned SAs. Actual ICMPv6 PTB headers, error queue, socket PMTU and route cache transitions are retained. The smaller public payload is verified by size/hash and protected return acknowledgement. No production authority or every PMTU condition is inferred.
preservation: Only newly named namespaces, routes, SAs, MTUs and filters are changed and removed after collection.
